lifespans.title: Tank water heater
lifespans.note: Leaks are the usual end, and they can soak a finished room or attic.

lifespans.title: Central air or heat pump
lifespans.note: Shorter in hot or coastal climates where it runs most of the year.

lifespans.title: Garage door opener
lifespans.note: Openers made before 1993 also lack the auto-reverse sensors now required.

lifespans.title: Gas furnace
lifespans.note: Past this age, cracked heat exchangers and scarce parts become more likely.

lifespans.title: Asphalt shingle roof
lifespans.note: About 20 years for flat three-tab shingles, 30 for thicker architectural ones; less in hot, humid places.

lifespans.title: Windows
lifespans.note: Aluminum frames last least, wood the longest. Fogging between panes often comes first.

lifespans.title: Septic system
lifespans.note: Only if the house is not on a city sewer. The drainfield is usually what fails.

lifespans.title: Electrical panel
lifespans.note: No authoritative service life exists; this range spans contractor rules of thumb and InterNACHI's 60 years.
